conventions: Format with Prettier defaults (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas, semicolons).

Follow ESLint import/order: builtin, external, @excalidraw/** (external after), internal, parent, sibling, index, object, type; always leave an empty line between every import statement (newlines-between: always-and-inside-groups).
Use separate type imports (`import type { ... } from ...`) to satisfy `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports` with zero ESLint warnings.
Never import from the barrel `packages/excalidraw/index.tsx` inside non-test source files; use direct relative imports such as `import type { BoxSelectionMode } from "../types"`.
Tests run under Vitest with jsdom and use `render`, `act`, `API`, `Pointer`, `Keyboard`, and `assertSelectedElements` from `packages/excalidraw/tests/test-utils` and `./helpers/*`.

decisions.topic: Mode parameter name and default on getLassoSelectedElementIds
decisions.choice: Accept optional `boxSelectionMode?: BoxSelectionMode` on `getLassoSelectedElementIds` input object, defaulting to `"overlap"` when omitted.
decisions.reason: Preserves backward compatibility for existing direct callers in `lasso.test.tsx` while matching `appState.boxSelectionMode` naming when `LassoTrail.updateSelection` passes `this.app.state.boxSelectionMode`.

decisions.topic: Element and bound-text enclosure in contain vs overlap mode
decisions.choice: In `"contain"` mode, skip bound-to-container text elements (`isBoundToContainer(element)`) on their own, require non-empty element segments with every segment endpoint inside `lassoPolygon` and zero `lassoSegments` intersecting `element`, and for arrows (`isArrowElement(element)`) with bound text (`getBoundTextElement`) also require the positioned bound text (`computeBoundTextPosition` + `getElementLineSegments`) to have all segment endpoints inside `lassoPolygon` and zero `lassoSegments` intersecting it.
rejected: Treating bound-to-container text on non-arrow containers as selectable or required in `"contain"` mode
decisions.reason: Matches `elementsOverlappingBBox` semantics while accurately handling concave lasso polygons across all shapes supported by `getElementLineSegments`.

decisions.topic: Group selection filtering in contain mode
decisions.choice: After collecting individually enclosed elements in `"contain"` mode, remove any enclosed element with `element.groupIds.length > 0` unless every non-deleted, unlocked, non-bound-text element in the scene (`elementsMap` and `elements`) whose `groupIds` includes `element.groupIds.at(-1)` is also in `enclosedElements`.
rejected: Allowing locked or bound-text group members to block group selection in `"contain"` mode
decisions.reason: Ensures off-screen or un-enclosed selectable group members block top-level group selection while locked and bound-text elements do not, matching `elementsOverlappingBBox`.
